lifecycle.session_end: a SessionEnd hook drops a marker; no close step yet

sources.read: each project folder's STATUS.md or README, its newest decision docs, and git log since the last read
open pull requests, reviews requested from me, issues assigned to me

sources.name: Linear, Jira, Trello, Notion or similar
sources.read: tasks assigned to me and comments since the last read

_notes.stages: Any ladder, any length. A course ladder: ["Reading", "Assignment", "Draft", "Feedback", "Submitted"]
_notes.closeout_stage: The stage that means one step from done; those projects sort first in Close out and hand off.
_notes.tracker_label: The word shown before a task id on a project page, like Task, Card or Issue.
_notes.page: Where index.html is written, relative to the data folder. Record hrefs are relative to this page.
_notes.github: Used only by refresh.js. repos like ["your-name/your-repo"]; people maps a GitHub login to a first name, like {"octo-login": "Sam"}. Delete it, or leave repos empty, if you have no GitHub. refresh.js --offline also skips it.
_notes.profile: Optional, set by setup. user_type: student, instructor, founder / lead / PM, solo developer, researcher or client work. project_types: the kinds of project you run. notes: one line the agent keeps in mind.
_notes.lifecycle: Optional, set by setup. status_file_names: where a project's status block lives. kickoffs_glob: resume prompts, the newest is where a project left off. sessions_table: a table of sessions, read for activity. session_end: one line on what your end-of-session hook or close step writes.
_notes.sources: Read by the agent, not by the scripts. Delete the ones you do not use. Every read is read-only. kind: local, github, tracker, calendar, mail, meetings, board or goals. via: the MCP server's name. access: read, read-only by policy, or not authorized (setup fills it).
_notes.today: Optional, YYYY-MM-DD: freezes the page's idea of today (the example uses it so its ages never drift).
